# Red Flame Gas Supplier

Red Flame Gas Supplier is an LPG (liquefied petroleum gas) distribution and gas
installation business in Cape Town, South Africa, trading from 170 Victoria Road,
Woodstock, Cape Town, 7925. Established 2020.

- Phone / WhatsApp: 064 510 9495
- Email: info@redflamegas.co.za
- Hours: Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00, Sat 08:00-12:00, Sun closed
- Website: https://www.redflamegas.co.za/

## Services

- [Gas Refill and Delivery](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/) — cylinder exchange and
  refills in 5 kg, 9 kg, 14 kg, 19 kg and 48 kg, any mainstream brand (Afrox, Easigas,
  Totalgaz), free same-day delivery.
- [Gas Installation with COC Certification](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/gas-installation-cape-town) —
  hobs and stoves, gas geysers, cylinder cages and banks, geyser repairs, SANS 10087
  compliant, Certificate of Compliance issued.
- [Gas Geyser Installation](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/gas-geyser-installation-cape-town)
- [Gas Hob and Stove Installation](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/gas-hob-stove-installation-cape-town)
- [Gas Geyser Repairs](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/gas-geyser-repairs-cape-town)
- Gas Cages and cylinder banks
- All general LPG gas products

## Pricing

Refill and exchange prices are for a cylinder the customer already owns, VAT
included, delivered free: 5 kg R240, 9 kg R399, 14 kg R610, 19 kg R799, 48 kg R1,850.
Gas installations start from R2,500, quoted in full after an on-site assessment; the
customer buys the appliance separately and Red Flame supplies the cylinder and cage.
Prices current as of September 2026 and revised periodically with the SA maximum LPG
price; see the site for the latest figures.

## Service area

Cape Town, primarily: [Woodstock](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/woodstock),
[Pinelands](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/pinelands),
[Claremont](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/claremont),
[Rondebosch](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/rondebosch),
Atlantic Seaboard, [Goodwood](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/goodwood),
[Parow](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/parow),
[Bellville](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/bellville),
[Table View](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/table-view), and
[Parklands](https://www.redflamegas.co.za/parklands). Same-day free delivery is
confirmed for Goodwood, Parow, Bellville, Table View and Parklands.
